races.display_title: Donohue Marquees Risk Of Thunder Chase
races.verdict: STUMPTOWN is a very smart performer in cross-country events, winning 5 times including this race, at the Cheltenham Festival and the historic Velka Pardubicka, and he looks to hold strong claims after reappearing with a victory over hurdles. The biggest threat could come from Fountain House , while The Goffer is also considered. STUMPTOWN (IRE) FOUNTAIN HOUSE (IRE) THE GOFFER (IRE)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict: A strong race of its type, but PLACE DE LA NATION was the best of these over hurdles having won a Grade 1 at the Punchestown Festival on her final start and, likely to make a chaser, she holds obvious appeal. races.display_title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: COCK AND BULL stepped up on his previous hurdling efforts when justifying strong support at Thurles 3 days and, with the longer trip not expected to be an issue, he looks capable of defying a 7-lb penalty and notching up a quick-fire double. King Of The Greys is another that arrives on the back of an improved win and is feared most, while the similarly unexposed pair The Rebel Fox and Tiger Twins are also capable of being involved if taking the required steps forward. COCK AND BULL (IRE) KING OF THE GREYS (IRE) THE REBEL FOX (IRE)
